node.title: Re^2: package variable does not persist
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
This is a good guess, and I think it's noteworthy that this happens even if the variable appears to be being set before use Module:

$ perl -I. -wMstrict -le '$Module::configvar=1; use Module; Module::menu();' in Module: false in menu(): true

Because [doc://use] gets run in an implicit BEGIN block, so the code in Module.pm will always be executed before the code that sets $Module::configvar=1;. One solution is to say BEGIN { $Module::configvar=1; } before use Module;.
